ammonia.reason: 140 mg/kg total ammonia but pH 3.59 traps as non-volatile NH4+, no deamination aging

animal_barnyard.reason: fresh yogurt, no p-cresol/indole from manure or long proteolysis

bitter.reason: minimal hydrophobic peptides from rennet-free, unaged acid gel; EPS cultures mask bitterness

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti, no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone methyl ketones

browning.reason: high moisture and pH 3.59 inhibit Maillard; denatured whey proteins do not brown

buttery.reason: diacetyl 117-145 umol/100g from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus/Streptococcus thermophilus

cheesy_sweaty.reason: very low lipolysis, FFA 0.045 meq/g, no rennet lipase and no aged butanoic acid

creaminess.reason: strained acid gel with 20% homogenized fat plus EPS from yogurt cultures gives smooth viscous mouthfeel

crumbliness.reason: cohesive acid casein gel, not a crumbly rennet curd

firmness.reason: spoonable strained yogurt, 23-46% solids with no rennet or press-hardening

floral_honey.reason: trace phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol only, no floral terpene development

fruity.reason: yogurt acetaldehyde 271-321 umol/100g gives green-apple/fruity note, almost no ethyl esters

goaty.reason: cow-milk base low in 4-methyloctanoic/caproic goat acids

malty_nutty.reason: no Strecker 3-methylbutanal or aged pyrazines, no propionibacteria

melt.reason: isoelectric acid casein at pH 3.59 wheys off and curdles, does not flow

oil_off.reason: stable acid emulsion despite 20% fat; slight oiling only when warmed or balls stored in oil

sour_vinegar.reason: pH 3.59-3.68 with 1.1-3.4% lactic acid from S. thermophilus/L. bulgaricus lactose fermentation

stretch.reason: no pasta-filata kneading, acid-precipitated casein lacks extensible network

sulfur_cooked.reason: milk boiled/85-90C 15-30 min plus yogurt H2S/DMS gives cooked-milk sulfur note

sweet.reason: lactose mostly fermented to lactate, low pH suppresses sweet perception

umami.reason: low free glutamate with no aged proteolysis to release umami peptides
